data.body: 67aa plan-review round 5: BLOCK (1 blocker + 2 advisories). B1 [G6]: drift-report output internally contradictory - plan both mandates a committed drift-report FILE and said 'no report file is written'. FIX: my round-4 phrase referred to the ADMISSION-SUMMARY file, not the drift report; reworded to 'the drift report and admitted specs are the only file outputs (no separate admission-summary file)'. A1 [T8]: drift entry required 'originating review' but the emitter's must-fire case carries no review-uuid - it embeds norm_id (fire) / review_event_uuid (pass) in the case input descriptor (verified in fixture_emit._input_descriptor). FIX: drift entry now cites criterion, case id, predicted/observed, and the embedded provenance id (norm_id for must-fire, review_event_uuid for must-not-fire); AC2 aligned. A2 [P6] AC/DoD quality: advisory. Desc 7981 chars, 11 ACs. Round 6 running.
